new_laws.law: Gross never meets Net. Every crossing percentage carries its basis; a perfect fill reads 100%.
Facts are READ from their source of truth, never re-derived downstream.

Evidence outranks value: every card answers HOW PROVEN before HOW GOOD.
The not-done is data: rejections resolve forward, trades spawn counterfactuals.
